# Document states

Generated by the state test (`go test -run TestStates -update`); do not edit.

## Axes

- **status**: draft, issued, cancelled
- **editing**: none, draft
- **number**: none, taken
- **share**: none, link
- **sources**: nothing, items

## Rules

| rule | bucket | reason | why | resolved by / guarded by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| draft-without-content | impossible |  | A never-issued document is its draft | by construction: discarding a never-issued draft deletes the document |
| number-before-issue | impossible |  | The number is taken on the first issue, so discarded drafts leave no gaps | by construction: Issue numbers the document as it first issues it |
| share-before-issue | impossible |  | A link opens issued content, so it exists once issued | by construction: Issue makes the link as it first issues it |
| cancelled-while-editing | impossible |  | A cancelled document can't be revised | documents.revise; by construction: Cancel drops the draft |
| draft-covers-nothing | impossible |  | A draft starts from what it covers, and keeps it until issued | documents.createDraft |

## States

48 combinations of the axes. 41 are impossible (an impossible rule holds) and left out. The 7 reachable ones (0 contradiction, 0 needs-action, 7 quiet) are shown as 3 rows, `*` meaning any value.
